##  Campaign Performance Analysis

**Goal:** Evaluate the effectiveness of a digital marketing campaign.

**What I did:**
- Analyzed engagement and conversion metrics
- Reviewed click-through rates (CTR)
- Identified top-performing channels

**Key Insight:**
Improved targeting increased engagement and reduced cost per conversion.

---

## Customer Segmentation

**Goal:** Identify different customer groups based on behavior.

**What I did:**
- Grouped customers using behavioral data
- Analyzed purchase patterns
- Identified high-value segments

**Key Insight:**
A small segment of customers drives a large portion of revenue.

---

## SEO / Engagement Analysis

**Goal:** Understand website traffic and user behavior.

**What I did:**
- Reviewed Google Analytics data
- Measured bounce rate and session duration
- Identified traffic sources

**Key Insight:**
Organic search was the strongest traffic driver.
